messages:
raj: Quick bug: usage dashboard is attributing requests to the service account owner even when the request used an exchange token and X-Delegated-Project header. Customers with project budgets see spikes in the SA owner project.
leah: Can you paste a minimal repro? headers + token type?
raj: Sure: ```
POST /v1/completions
Authorization: Bearer exch-tok-zzzy
X-Delegated-Project: proj-payment-ui
X-Trace-ID: trace-9001
```
raj: The exchange token was minted from sa-owner via our token-exchange flow, but the router resolves billing project to sa-owner-project.
morgan: That was by design originally: we trusted token principal for billing to avoid relying on arbitrary headers. But exchange tokens are signed and verifiable now, yeah?
devon: Correct — exchange tokens include an `orig_project` claim when minted via our exchange service. Router's lib currently doesn't read that claim for service_account-derived tokens.
maya: That mismatch will confuse customers and CS. Also could break org-level quota enforcement if enforcement keys off the owner project.
leah: Plan: 1) surface telemetry to detect occurrences (origin_header present vs attributed_project), 2) extend router identity resolution to prefer exchange claim when `exchange_proof=true`, 3) expose org opt-in toggle in console.
morgan: Telemetry dims: `auth.attribution.mismatch` (count), `auth.attribution.source` (header|exchange|token), `auth.attribution.validated` (t|f). Tag by org and route.
devon: Add audit payload per request: `attribution_resolved=proj-payment-ui,source=exchange,proof_verified=true` to request logs. Keep behind FF.
leah: I'll throw together a quick mismatch panel showing top 50 orgs with counts and delta on billing totals. That'll help catch enterprise customers.
morgan: UX: in the quotas/usage table show two columns: "Displayed project" and "Billing project" with a hover that explains precedence rules. Also place an "Attribution mode" entry in org settings (default token-owner, optional delegated-first).
maya: Need legal/sales signoff for default change. If we flip default, some contracts tied to owner project billing may break. So start opt-in only.
devon: Rollout suggestion: telemetry collection for 10 days, feature flag enabled for 5 test orgs, then 1% traffic canary, then 10% + org opt-in. After 30 days of clean telemetry consider default flip but only with cross-team approvals.
raj: I'll create a sampling job to capture full headers for mismatches (PII scrubbed) and share with CS for impacted tenants.
leah: Also add metric `auth.exchange.token_count` so we can quantify how many requests even use exchange tokens.
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-3001 created: router: support exchange-claim attribution + telemetry + FF.
morgan: Dev scope OK? devon, can you break into small PRs: (A) telemetry + audit logs, (B) router resolution change behind FF, (C) console UI pieces behind org toggle.
devon: Yep. I'll do (A) & (B) first. (C) needs Joyce/Product but we can land the API surface.
morgan: Please add a migration note so billing pipeline can optionally consume `resolved_attribution` for downstream accounting.
maya: I'll loop in account leads for the tenanted opt-in list.
leah: I'll drop a prototype dashboard link here when ready.
raj: Thanks all. No immediate rollback risk; keep it behind FF until dashboards look good.
ops-bot: Reminder: enable log retention for FF audits = 30d by default.
